svg.title: Trajectory
svg.desc: Dec 2021: B.Tech, Computer Science, DYPCOE · Kolhapur; May 2024: Machine Learning Intern, Infosys Springboard; Jun 2025: Graduated, CGPA 8.2, DYPCOE · Kolhapur; Aug 2025: Full-Stack Engineer Intern, GoParkEasy · Remote; Nov 2025: Full-Stack Engineer, GoParkEasy · Mumbai; Now: Building what's next, Open to hard problems

g.text: Two internships, one degree and a platform built from
